{
  "title": "Nexus Intelligence Hub: Immersive AI-Driven Solution Architect",
  "sprint_priority": "high",
  "full_brd_markdown": "# Business Requirements Document (BRD): Nexus Intelligence Hub

## 1. Executive Summary
Based on competitive market research of industry leaders (Simform, Appinventiv, WillowTree), there is a clear trend toward merging high-performance web frameworks with immersive 3D visualization and autonomous AI agents. The **Nexus Intelligence Hub** is a new website module designed to provide an interactive, 3D-rendered 'Digital Twin' environment where users can interact with an AI Agent to configure complex enterprise software solutions in real-time.

## 2. Project Objectives
*   **Immersive Engagement:** Utilize Three.js to create a 3D visualization of software architectures or product ecosystems.
*   **Intelligent Guidance:** Deploy an Agentic AI (RAG-based) to assist users in navigating technical requirements.
*   **Enterprise Performance:** Build on Next.js to ensure sub-second page loads and SEO optimization for lead generation.

## 3. Target Audience
*   CTOs and Technical Decision Makers looking for enterprise-grade solutions.
*   Product Managers requiring a visual 'Digital Twin' of their proposed software ecosystem.
*   Sales Teams needing a high-fidelity tool for complex solution demonstrations.

## 4. Functional Requirements

### 4.1. Immersive 3D Canvas (Three.js Integration)
*   **FR1:** The module shall render a 3D interactive environment representing a 'Digital Twin' of a client's technical infrastructure.
*   **FR2:** Users must be able to drag-and-drop 3D components (servers, databases, API nodes) to visualize their stack.
*   **FR3:** Real-time rendering of data flows between 3D nodes to simulate system performance.

### 4.2. Agentic AI Orchestrator (AI Agent Integration)
*   **FR4:** A persistent AI Agent sidebar (built with LangChain/AutoGPT principles) shall guide the user through the configuration.
*   **FR5:** The agent must utilize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to answer technical questions based on our internal whitepapers and documentation.
*   **FR6:** The agent shall perform multi-step tasks, such as generating a cost estimate or a technical PDF summary based on the 3D configuration.

### 4.3. Core Web Architecture (Next.js Framework)
*   **FR7:** Use Server-Side Rendering (SSR) for the initial load of the 3D environment to ensure high performance.
*   **FR8:** Implement Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) for the 'Solution Library' section to keep case studies updated without full rebuilds.
*   **FR9:** The module must be fully responsive, degrading gracefully from 3D to 2D for mobile devices.

## 5. Non-Functional Requirements
*   **Performance:** The 3D canvas must maintain 60 FPS on mid-range desktop hardware.
*   **Scalability:** The AI Agent backend must support concurrent user sessions using a composable architecture.
*   **Security:** All user-generated configurations must be encrypted and stored in compliance with SOC2 standards.

## 6. Technical Stack (Based on Market Research)
*   **Frontend:** Next.js 14+ (App Router), Tailwind CSS.
*   **3D Engine:** Three.js / React Three Fiber.
*   **AI Layer:** OpenAI GPT-4o API, LangChain for agentic workflows, Pinecone for RAG vector storage.
*   **Deployment:** Vercel (optimized for Next.js and edge functions).

## 7. Success Metrics
*   **Lead Conversion:** 25% increase in 'Request a Quote' submissions via the AI Agent.
*   **User Retention:** Average time spent on the module > 4 minutes.
*   **Performance Score:** Google Lighthouse Performance score > 90.

## 8. Implementation Roadmap
*   **Phase 1:** Next.js boilerplate and Three.js environment setup.
*   **Phase 2:** AI Agent integration with RAG capabilities.
*   **Phase 3:** UI/UX polishing and enterprise API integration for automated proposal generation."
}
